blocks.tamil_translation: the ghanimah (spoils) obtained has been made halal for me. The ghanimah of earlier nations would be burnt up by fire coming down (it was not made halal for them). 4. The whole earth has been made a place of Salah for me. (In the earlier nations, worship could be performed only in specific places.) The soil of the whole earth has been made pure for me. (So one may purify oneself by doing tayammum with soil.) 5. I have been sent as a Prophet to all of creation. (Each of the other Prophets was sent as a Prophet only for some particular nation.) 6. The coming of the Prophets has been sealed with me (no Prophet or Messenger will come after me),” said the Prophet ﷺ. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- Short sentences of concise words that contain very broad meanings are called “Jawami' al-Kalim’

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عِرْبَاضِ بْنِ سَارِيَةَ ﵁ صَاحِبِ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: إِنِّي عَبْدُ اللهِ وَخَاتَمُ النَّبِيِّينَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحدبت) رواه الحاكم وقال هذا حديث صحيح الاسناد ولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذهبي:٢ /٤١٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “Indeed I am the slave of Allah and the Seal (the last) of the Prophets!” The Companion Hazrat Irbad ibn Sariyah (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ مَثَلِي وَمَثَلَ اْلاَنْبِيَاءِ مِنْ قَبْلِي كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ بَنَي بَيْتاً فَأَحْسَنَهُ وَأَجْمَلَهُ إِلَّا مَوْضِعَ
